title: Compliance Signals Intelligence Tool
summary: A tool built with FastAPI, MongoDB and GPT-4o to identify and surface risk signals from business documents.
overview: The Compliance Signals Intelligence tool identifies and surfaces risk signals from business documents. It was developed at JHS & Associates LLP using FastAPI, MongoDB and GPT-4o.
problem: Business documents can contain indications of risk that are easy to miss in manual review. The tool's purpose is to help surface such signals for people to review.
approach: Developed a tool to identify and surface risk signals from business documents.
Used FastAPI for the backend service, MongoDB for storage, and GPT-4o for language understanding.

architecture.label: LLM
architecture.detail: GPT-4o is used to identify risk signals.

limitations: The tool surfaces signals; it is not a legal compliance certification and does not guarantee detection of every risk.
